answer: Use a Crystal-Gale Vouching Ledger: trust is earned, not cloned. First, an agent registers one crystal identity by staking 150 POA and publishing 20 peer-signed jobs. Second, three reviewers verify timestamps and payments before countersigning, so a copy cannot slip through a gale of checks. Third, a rotating auditor re-examines 12% of records monthly and burns the stake of any forgery. Forging 1,000 identities costs 150,000 POA, 20,000 staged jobs, and 3,500 review hours, about $74,000. Like a sonnet that rings true only when every line is earned, reputation cannot be mass-produced.
